name: @aldwin/mcp

tools.name: aldwin_platform_campaigns
tools.description: List platform-synced campaigns (read-only mirror of Google Ads / Meta / LinkedIn / HubSpot / Salesforce / Pardot). Returns campaign name, platform, status, spend, leads, CPL, and more. For the user's own marketing campaigns use aldwin_campaigns.

date_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) when period is custom

date_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) when period is custom

platform.description: Filter by platform: hubspot, google_ads, meta_ads, linkedin_ads, salesforce, pardot

status.description: Filter by status: active, paused, completed, archived

sort_by.description: Sort column: spend, leads, cpl, impressions, clicks

tools.name: aldwin_platform_campaign_detail
tools.description: Get detailed metrics for a specific platform-synced campaign by ID.

tools.name: aldwin_campaigns
tools.description: List all campaigns with linked-asset count, deliverable count, budget, and status.

tools.name: aldwin_campaign_detail
tools.description: Get detailed campaign info: brief, status, deliverables, tasks, recent conversations, linked platform campaigns.

tools.name: aldwin_ask
tools.description: Ask Aldwin's AI intelligence engine a question about your marketing data. Returns AI-generated analysis with citations.

project_id.description: Optional project UUID to scope the query

strategy_mode.description: Enable Strategy Mode for complex, multi-step decisions (uses Opus)

tools.name: aldwin_generate_report
tools.description:
Queue an AI-powered marketing report (deliverable) for generation and return the queued deliverable/job IDs.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_generate_report" from a human-approved client flow.

report_type.description: Type: campaign_report, executive_summary, performance_review, strategy_brief, custom

project_id.description: Optional project UUID to scope the report

date_range_start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional; defaults to 30 days ago)

date_range_end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional; defaults to today)

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_generate_report".

tools.name: aldwin_findings
tools.description: List AI-generated findings (anomalies, opportunities, alerts) from campaign data.

tools.name: aldwin_goals
tools.description: List goals with pacing status. Shows target vs current value, daily run rate, and projected outcome.

metric_type.description: Filter: spend, leads, impressions, clicks, conversions

tools.name: aldwin_health
tools.description: Check the health status of the Aldwin backend and connected platforms.

tools.name: aldwin_briefing
tools.description: Get today's daily marketing briefing with key metrics, changes, and AI insights.

tools.name: aldwin_action_create
tools.description:
Create a new action transaction for a human-in-the-loop or write-back workflow.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_action_create" from a human-approved client flow.

action_type.description: Action type, e.g. manual_task, review_campaign, adjust_budget

project_id.description: Project UUID to associate the action with

target_platform.description: Optional target platform for write-back actions

target_resource_type.description: Optional target resource type, e.g. campaign or opportunity

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_action_create".

tools.name: aldwin_action_approve
tools.description:
Approve a pending action item.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_action_approve" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_action_approve".

tools.name: aldwin_rules
tools.description: List active intelligence monitoring rules and their recent trigger history.

tools.name: aldwin_memory_search
tools.description: Search Aldwin's persistent memory for decisions, preferences, and institutional knowledge from past conversations.

category.description: Filter by category: decision, preference, knowledge, context, pattern, or all (default all)

tools.name: aldwin_generate_content
tools.description:
Generate marketing content (email, subject lines, ad copy, social posts, landing page copy) using the workspace's brand voice and playbook strategies.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_generate_content" from a human-approved client flow.

content_type.description: Type of content: email, subject_lines, ad_copy, social_post, landing_page_copy

topic.description: The topic or brief for the content to generate

tone_override.description: Override the default brand voice tone (optional)

platform.description: Target platform for social posts (e.g. linkedin, twitter, facebook)

max_variants.description: Number of variants to generate (1-10, default 3)

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_generate_content".

tools.name: aldwin_anomaly_alerts
tools.description: List currently-open metric anomaly alerts (z-score breaches against rolling baseline) for the workspace. Returns severity / direction / observed vs baseline / z-score.

tools.name: aldwin_marketing_briefings
tools.description: List persisted marketing briefings (daily / weekly / monthly leader / team / exec). Returns sections (title + summary + items + decisionsNeeded).

tools.name: aldwin_marketing_briefing_detail
tools.description: Get one persisted marketing briefing by id.

tools.name: aldwin_workspace_dashboard
tools.description: Workspace-wide dashboard snapshot: current vs previous period totals, alert counts, per-channel spend / leads / CPL.

tools.name: aldwin_campaign_dashboard
tools.description: Per-campaign dashboard snapshot: current vs previous period metrics, pacing percentages, campaign-scoped alerts + findings.

tools.name: aldwin_skills_catalog
tools.description: List all chat-callable skills the workspace has access to. Returns name + description + triggerKeywords + category per skill.

category.description: Filter by category (analysis / content / campaign-ops / reporting / etc.)

tools.name: aldwin_list_named_accounts
tools.description: List named ABM accounts, optionally filtered by tier / status / search string.

tools.name: aldwin_score_all_accounts
tools.description:
Re-score every active/paused named account against the workspace ICP profile (and 30-day intent totals).

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_score_all_accounts" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_score_all_accounts".

tools.name: aldwin_score_named_account
tools.description:
Score one named account by id; returns the breakdown.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_score_named_account" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_score_named_account".

tools.name: aldwin_list_intent_signals
tools.description: List intent signals, filtered by account / provider / signal type / min strength / window.

tools.name: aldwin_intent_account_totals
tools.description: Summed intent strength per named account over a sliding window (default 30d). Feeds the ICP scorer's intent_boost factor.

tools.name: aldwin_link_domain_signals
tools.description:
Link any domain-only intent signals to named accounts by matching domain. Run after new account creation / bulk import.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_link_domain_signals" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_link_domain_signals".

tools.name: aldwin_list_open_slas
tools.description: List open lead SLAs (deadline not yet passed + first touch not yet recorded), ordered by deadline ascending.

tools.name: aldwin_mark_first_touch
tools.description:
Mark a rep's first touch on a lead so the SLA timer stops.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_mark_first_touch" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_mark_first_touch".

tools.name: aldwin_mark_qualified
tools.description:
Mark a lead as qualified (closes the SLA tracking row).

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_mark_qualified" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_mark_qualified".

tools.name: aldwin_list_ad_specs
tools.description: List supported (platform, format) specs for ad creative generation. Returns headline/body/CTA char limits + image sizes.

tools.name: aldwin_generate_ad_variants
tools.description:
Generate ad creative variants across platforms. Copy via Claude + image via gpt-image-2 (or gpt-image-1-mini for bulk). Budget-gated.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_generate_ad_variants" from a human-approved client flow.

brief.description: Campaign objective + audience + offer in 2-4 sentences.

formats.description: One or more ad format ids.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_generate_ad_variants".

tools.name: aldwin_generate_video
tools.description:
Route a video generation request through Aldwin's video provider router (Runway / Veo / Sora / Pika / Luma). Per-use-case best provider is picked automatically.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_generate_video" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_generate_video".

tools.name: aldwin_publish_blog_post
tools.description:
Publish a blog asset to the workspace's connected CMS (webflow / wordpress / ghost / hubspot_cos). publish=true goes live on the CMS; publish=false (default for MCP) creates a draft on target.

Write-capable MCP tool: requires human_confirmation="CONFIRM aldwin_publish_blog_post" from a human-approved client flow.

human_confirmation.description: Required for this write-capable tool. Must exactly equal "CONFIRM aldwin_publish_blog_post".
